what_this_is: Spinless vacuum of Einstein+Λ with Λ>0 is de Sitter. Not entanglement selection. Not a prize claim.
what_is_P: G_μν+Λ g_μν=0 and Λ>0 ⇒ de Sitter (maximally symmetric). Torsion vanishes with the spin. Cosmology is metric.
what_is_not_P: Entanglement first law selects Λ or dS. FGHMV in cosmology. A Nobel-grade derivation of our universe.
